newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-FORMER LEAGUE MAN SUMMONED BY ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FORMER LEAGUE MAN SUMMONED BY ENGLAND.

text.p: Winger Jim Fallon has earned the distinction of being the first former rugby league player to be included in England's senior rugby union squad.
Fallon won four England A caps in 1992 before switching codes to join Leeds, but is now back in the 15-a-side game with Richmond.

He was called up at short notice on Tuesday as injuries forced England to invite more than 50 players to a training session ahead of their pre-Christmas internationals against Italy, the New Zealand Barbarians and Argentina.
England's management are keen to stage a meaningful practice match on Wednesday after around 15 players were unfit to take part in a session two weeks ago.
Wales' Scott Gibbs became the first British player to win an international union cap since returning from league when he was selected against Italy in Rome last weekend.
